title: Implement M4 Stage timing and local Evidence diagnostics
goal: Expose deterministic reuse identity and monotonic execution timing while keeping developer-machine Evidence advisory.
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic results record total Stage and Module elapsed milliseconds without adding timing values to content identity.
Every dependency reports executed or reused source freshness content match producer class and decision reason.
Local Evidence is always marked local-advisory and authoritative false even when exact content matches.
Existing evidence queries preserve and validate the semantic result without a new trust or mutation surface.
No CI selection Windows cadence protected component or performance threshold changes occur.
risks: Content-equivalent local Evidence could be displayed as trusted or timing could make identity nondeterministic.
decisions: Separate content identity from producer trust and exclude all timing fields from reuse hashes.
